findings.title: Failed stats request is shown as 'No harvests in this range' instead of an error
findings.steps: Sign in, open Stats. Make GET /api/stats/harvests return 500 (text/plain body) or go offline, then change the From date (or open /stats directly).
findings.expected: An error message saying the stats could not be loaded, with a Retry button.
findings.actual: The page shows the empty state 'No harvests in this range. Pick a different date range, or log a harvest…'. There is no error message and no retry. The page only reads `data` and `status` from useApiFetch and ignores `error`, so any failure falls through to the EmptyState v-else branch.
findings.evidence: With the mock in place, the main text was: 'From / To / This year / No harvests in this range / Pick a different date range, or log a harvest to see it here.' The dashboard, by contrast, uses summaryError with AlertMessage.

findings.title: From date after To date (server 422) is shown as an empty range with no reason
findings.steps: On Stats, type From = 2026-12-01 and To = 2026-02-01. The min/max attributes do not stop typed values.
findings.expected: A visible message like 'The From date must be on or before the To date.', which the API already returns.
findings.actual: The page shows 'No harvests in this range', which wrongly suggests the range is valid and empty.
findings.evidence: The API returns 422 {"detail":"The From date must be on or before the To date."}, and the UI shows the empty state.

findings.title: Invalid date in the URL (e.g. ?from=2026-02-30) is shown as empty instead of being rejected or explained
findings.expected: Fall back to the default date, or show a validation error.
findings.actual: queryDate() only checks the \d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} pattern, so the impossible date is sent. The API answers 422 and the page says 'No harvests in this range'.
findings.evidence: The main text was the empty-state message. curl returns 422 'day value is outside expected range'.

findings.title: No request timeout: a hung stats request spins forever while the previous range's data stays on screen
findings.steps: On Stats, make /api/stats/harvests hang (route never answers), then change From to 2026-04-01 and wait more than 10 s.
findings.expected: After 10 s the request fails and the page shows an error with a retry.
findings.actual: After 13 s the page still showed 'Loading stats…' along with the old 1 Jan–31 Dec 2026 table and best plants, even though the From field said 1 Apr. useApiFetch sets no timeout, and the stale table is not hidden or marked while loading.
findings.evidence: After 13 s the text showed 'Loading stats…' and the caption 'Harvest weight per plant and month, 1 Jan 2026 to 31 Dec 2026'.

findings.title: Error state cannot be retried without a reload
findings.steps: Make the request fail, then restore the server.
findings.expected: A Retry button that reloads the stats.
findings.actual: There is no error UI and no retry. The only way to recover is to change a date or reload the page. `refresh` is never exposed.
findings.evidence: Code: stats.vue destructures only { data, status }. There is no button in the failed state.

findings.title: Null fields in a response render as the text 'null'
findings.steps: Mock /api/stats/harvests with harvest_count: null (and date fields null).
findings.actual: The results line reads 'null harvests from – to –'.
findings.evidence: The text was 'null harvests from – to –'. This only happens with a mocked response; the real backend always sends numbers.
